title: How to stop "Wheel Creaking" on Z1-D Plus Roboscooter Self Balancing Vehicles.
description:
After a year of hard use in rain and snow, I found my Z1-D Plus Stand up Vehicle (SUV) had a wheel creaking.  Removing and tightening the wheel did NOT help, so I dug into it further and found the cause and created this fix.  Ride easy and be safe. These machines are from http://www.roboscooters.com  Thanks for watching.

Dave Herbert
~NightFlyyer~Tm
AMA L-8221 Scientific Div
